step.consentReply: Answer to a stop or start

reason.MASTER_OFF: The messages master switch was off
reason.STEP_OFF: This step is switched off in the journey
reason.QUIET_HOURS: Waiting for the quiet hours to end
reason.ORDER_MOVED_ON: The order had moved on; the message no longer fitted
reason.REASON_SILENT: A cancel reason that sends nothing
reason.NO_RECIPIENT: No number or e-mail for this channel
reason.CAP_SMS: The SMS limit per order was reached
reason.CAP_WHATSAPP: The WhatsApp limit per order was reached
reason.CAP_EMAIL: The e-mail limit per order was reached
reason.CAP_TOTAL: The total limit per order was reached
reason.AMOUNT_RULE: Nothing left to pay, so a line with the amount was not sent
reason.NO_LINK: The shop's address is not known yet, so the link could not go
reason.UNKNOWN_TOKEN: The text has a {word} the system does not know
reason.RETRY: Failed; it will be tried again
reason.NO_SENDER: The channel could not be reached
reason.PROVIDER_FAILED: WhatsApp said it could not be delivered
reason.WA_TEMPLATE_NOT_APPROVED: WhatsApp has not approved this text yet, so the other channel was used
reason.OPTED_OUT: The customer stopped messages on this channel
reason.NO_CONSENT: An offer, and the customer has not said yes to offers

log.title: Message log
log.sub: Every message the shop meant to send: when, to whom, its state, why it was skipped, its parts and cost.
log.empty: No message yet. Messages show here as soon as orders come in.
log.retryFailed: Still failing — check the number on the order first

channels.title: Channels & limits
channels.sub: One master switch for every customer message; each channel runs on its practice mode until its key is added.
channels.masterHelp: Off = nothing goes to any customer. Order updates, answers and campaigns all stop.
channels.providersHelp: Which service each channel uses. Add or change a key in Settings → Keys & connections.
channels.creditError: The credit could not be read: {why}
channels.maskingHelp: A name like your brand instead of a number. The SMS company must approve it first; ask them, then mark it here.
channels.maskName: Sender name (up to 11 letters or digits)
channels.maskUse: Send from this name once it is approved
channels.ratesHelp: From your SMS company's price list. Used for the cost in the log when the company does not say it. Empty = not known.
channels.capsHelp: At most this many order messages per channel and in total. Empty = no limit. Cancel and money notices are outside the limits.
channels.quietHelp: A message that falls in these hours waits until they end. "Order received" never waits.
channels.consentOpen: Who stopped messages, and the stop words

err.STALE: Someone else saved this page a moment ago. It now shows their version; make your change again.
err.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your sign-in has ended. Sign in again.
err.other: It could not be saved. Try again.
err.NOT_RETRYABLE: This message cannot be tried again (it is not failed, or it already went another way).
err.NOT_FOUND: It is not there any more. Reload the page.
err.PROVIDER_ERROR: The service did not answer. Try again in a minute. ({fields})

wa.title: WhatsApp templates
wa.sub: A WhatsApp the shop starts goes only with words Meta approved. Send each text for approval here and read Meta's answer back.
wa.liveNote: Live: until a text is approved, its message goes by the other channel (the step's fallback).
wa.mockNote: Practice mode: messages are not really sent, and the practice service approves at once. Nothing goes to Meta.
wa.noSync: This service cannot list templates. Connect WhatsApp in Settings → Keys & connections.
wa.none: No WhatsApp texts yet. They are added in Messages → Templates.

problem.STARTS_WITH_VALUE: Meta refuses a text that begins with a {word}. Put a word before it.
problem.ENDS_WITH_VALUE: Meta refuses a text that ends with a {word}. Put a word after it.
problem.VALUES_TOUCH: Two {words} side by side are refused. Put a word between them.
problem.TOO_LONG: Too long for WhatsApp (1,024 characters at most).

wa.submitted: Sent. Meta usually answers within a day; press Check approvals then.
wa.submitAsk: Send this text to Meta for approval? The sample order fills the {words} as examples.

consent.title: Consent
consent.sub: Who stopped which messages. A customer who writes STOP gets nothing more on that channel; offers go only to those who said yes.
consent.lookupHelp: Type a customer's mobile number to see what he said on each channel.
consent.noHistory: Nothing recorded for this number yet.
consent.recentHelp: Every answer, newest first: from the checkout, the customer's account, his reply, or the team.
consent.rulesHelp: The words that stop and restart messages, what a stop covers, and which journey steps are offers. A stop is always honoured.
consent.wordsHelp: Separate words with commas. Capital or small letters do not matter; the whole reply must be the word.
consent.confirmReplyHelp: Off as it ships. On: he gets one short message saying it is done.
consent.offerStepsHelp: A ticked step goes only to a customer who said yes to offers on that channel. None is ticked as it ships.
consent.recordHelp: When a customer asks the team by phone or in person. It is saved with your name.
consent.recordAsk: Record this answer for the number? Messages follow it from now on.
